title: Creamy Mac and Cheese Casserole
description: A comforting and indulgent vegetarian casserole loaded with macaroni, cheese, and a creamy sauce.
instructions: Cook the macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute, creating a roux.
Slowly add in the milk, whisking continuously until the sauce thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in the cheddar and mozzarella cheese until melted.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked macaroni, cheese sauce, and a pinch of salt.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish and top with additional grated cheese.
Dot the top with the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
